Name: Flight Controller Mount
Description: Custom 3D-printed mount to securely attach the micro flight controller to the drone frame, providing vibration isolation.

Description: Custom 3D-printed holder to secure the small LiPo battery to the drone frame, preventing movement during aggressive flight.

Name: Camera Module Mount
Description: Custom 3D-printed mount to securely position the onboard recording camera at an optimal angle on the drone frame.

Name: Microphone Housing
Description: Tiny 3D-printed enclosure for the miniature microphone, protecting it while allowing sound capture.

Name: Fly Body Enclosure
Description: Lightweight 3D-printed enclosure shaped like a fly's body, designed to house and protect internal electronics while maintaining a 'fly-like' aesthetic.

Name: M2 Nylon Mounting Screws
Description: Lightweight nylon screws used for mounting the flight controller and other small components to reduce overall weight.

Name: M2 Nylon Nuts
Description: Lightweight nylon nuts for securing M2 screws on the drone frame.

Name: Miniature Cable Ties
Description: Small cable ties for managing and securing wiring within the compact drone body.
